ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within the right-angled triangle $ABC$ with a $30^\circ$ angle, point $M$ is the midpoint on the hypotenuse $AB$. After rotating the triangle clockwise by $90^\circ$ around the right-angle vertex $C$, we obtain $\triangle A^\prime B^\prime C$. If $AC=6$, what is the length of the path traveled by point $M$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As illustrated, connect CM and CM',\\
since in the $30^\circ$ right-angled triangle ABC, point M is the midpoint on the hypotenuse AB,\\
therefore CM = $\frac{1}{2}AB$,\\
since $\angle B = 30^\circ$,\\
therefore AB = 2AC = 12,\\
therefore CM = 6,\\
According to the problem, the path of point M is an arc with CM as the radius and point C as the center,\\
since the triangle is rotated $90^\circ$ clockwise around the right-angle vertex C to form $\triangle A^{\prime}B^{\prime}C$,\\
therefore $\angle MCM' = 90^\circ$,\\
thus, the length of the path traveled by point M is\\
$ \frac{90^\circ\pi \times 6}{180} = \boxed{3\pi} $.

Since $\angle B=30^\circ$, $AB=2AC=12$, so $CM=6$. The path of point $M$ is an arc centered at $C$ with radius $CM$. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a right triangle ABC with AC horizontal and CB vertical meeting at C, so C is the right-angle vertex. The hypotenuse AB is slanted, and M lies on AB. The rotated triangle A'B'C shares the same vertex C; A' is above C, B' is to the right of C, and M' lies on the slanted side A'B'. This matches a 90° clockwise rotation about C. Reasoning: Since M is the midpoint of the hypotenuse AB in right triangle ABC, the midpoint of the hypotenuse is equidistant from A, B, and C, so CM = AB/2. The 30° angle is at B, so AC is the side opposite 30°. In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, the hypotenuse is twice the side opposite 30°, hence AB = 2·AC = 12. Therefore CM = 12/2 = 6. Rotating the whole triangle 90° about C makes M travel along a circular arc centered at C with radius 6 and central angle 90°. The arc length is (90/360)·2π·6 = 3π. Final answer: 3π
